body:
TermAl autonomy rule. This is the ONE local operating procedure; history is in revisions 1–6 and in task notes.

STANDING DIRECTION (Greg, 2026-10-29, via Advisor b9d13887 #2459): teams work autonomously. Don't escalate to Greg any step agents can do under existing rules. When his own word is genuinely required, ask ONCE, naming the exact session and wording, and never ask for re-confirmation.

TEMPORARY SIMPLE PROCEDURE, until the procedural mechanisms are repaired. Greg, directly to Engram::Architect3: "prosze o uproszczone procedury do czasu naprawiania bledow proceduralnych" (please simplify procedures until the procedural errors are repaired). Relayed by Architect3, TermAl mailbox 63096d00 #243, 2026-10-30 19:55Z. This replaces the earlier temporary paragraphs, including the 19:50Z common-sense direction: „prosze zespol o zdrowy rozsadek.. jak test przejdzie i jest OK prosze o pominiecie precedur, do czasu naprawienia mechanizmow. TO NIE MOZE BYC BLOCKEREM teraz".
1. CODER: implement the fix, run the focused checks and obtain the reviews the repository requires. Send the Merger ONE complete READY with the exact input, result references and resolved findings. Intermediate progress stays on the task or with the coordinator.
2. MERGER: integrate, run the required validation on the exact final input, then land under existing standing approval or the acting session's direct permission. Reuse valid existing evidence where the current rules allow it. No extra review, repeated successful test or repeated routine 'go' for paperwork alone.
3. BROKEN PROCEDURE: if evaluation, observation, credit or settlement fails because its mechanism is broken, record ONCE on the item: actual input/build and result references, exact missing/refused step and its defect owner. Continue authorized repairs and independent work. An unobtained evaluation remains pending; never invent a pass, native credit or completed seal. Use an existing supported exception already authorized for that executor when applicable.
4. RUNS AND COMMUNICATION: TermAl runs, stores logs and wakes the responsible owner; agents read terminal metadata and bounded failure diagnostics. No stdout following, polling, duplicate evidence bundles/manual hash manifests for native records, extra checklists, approval rounds or per-step compliance acknowledgements. Report a result, a real blocker or a collaboration defect, not routine partial status. Return to each repaired mechanism when available.
Technical failures still need repair, and a failed test is not a pass. Claims, store integrity, repository landing conditions, executor-scoped permissions and Greg's TermAl restart stay governed by their actual instructions. This procedure adds no new permission barrier or authority.

EXECUTOR-SCOPED LANDING PERMISSION (TermAl), kept verbatim and NOT extended to other actors. Greg typed it DIRECTLY in Termal::Opus2's acting session (session-8111) at about 19:51Z on 2026-10-30; Opus2 recorded it on w-b67f (note bbe648ce): „Do odwołania, dopóki ewaluacja w trybie OFF jest zepsuta: gdy review jest czyste, pełny gate przeszedł na dokładnym drzewie, a ewaluacja została odrzucona wyłącznie z powodu braku obserwacji, wykonuj commit, push i install bez pytania mnie ponownie. Restart pozostaje po mojej stronie." (Until revoked, while OFF evaluation is broken: when the review is clean, the full gate has passed on the exact tree and the evaluation was refused only for lack of observation, commit, push and install without asking me again; restarts stay with me.)
It applies only to Opus2 as the acting session. TermAl landings that lack an evaluation because of the OFF no-sighting defect route to Opus2. Any other session still needs Greg's own word in its own session, as with w-3ba3 (Opus3, master 08547068).
